notes: CLAUDE.md: add the Compact Instructions section from templates/claude/compact-instructions.md (a governing change).
CODEOWNERS: bin/wf-adopt now writes .github/CODEOWNERS (`* @OWNER`, then `/docs/workflow/tasks/` and `/docs/workflow/feedback/`); add one if the project has none (procedures/setup.md step 5).
A single-owner manual-mode project: bin/wf-protect --apply turns auto-merge off, so replace the AGENTS.md sentence that turns it on with the new scaffold's (a governing change).
Enforced and owner-merge projects: a production pull request needs the delivery evidence block in its description (procedures/execute.md); the refreshed .github/workflows/wf-ci.yml reads it.
Owner-merge projects: choose a checkpoint (milestone, change or plan) with bin/wf-setup, and replace AGENTS.md's merge sentence with the new scaffold's, before the agent may merge.

Central reporting is removed: delete its external operations config and private runtime directory if you made them (they live outside the repository), and the profile's central-reporting lines under Workflow configuration.
Routine delegation is removed: if CODEOWNERS un-owned routine paths for it, own them again (`* @OWNER`).

Only where docs/workflow/config.json names paths.acceptance_tests: a mapped test of a scenario an in-progress milestone still waits on (an open task serving it, other than the pull request's) may now fail, including one that passes today: check tests/acceptance-map.json for such scenarios before moving the pin.

For scenarios with a test (mapped, or automated awaiting one), task-record changes that add a waiting task or complete a scenario without a test run now go to the owner (owner-merge), need a milestone record change (enforced) or an explicit baseline receipt (manual): mark a task Done in the pull request that delivers it.

To approve acceptance tests before the work: authorise the milestone, add the tests in its first task (procedures/readiness.md), and run them in a required CI job that fails on any test `wf pending --branch HEAD_BRANCH` lists as required.

Optional: give each milestone a client_title, client_outcome and client_measure, and the profile a client_measure, in the client's words and language, for the client page (wf status --client). Each is a governing-record change.
Optional: write a client plan file (phases and steps in the client's words, each step naming its milestones) and set client.plan in docs/workflow/config.json; a governing-record change.

If the client page is installed: `bin/wf-upgrade` refreshes .github/workflows/wf-client-page.yml from this release, so the page rebuilds within minutes of any push and reads the branches (--live); an enforcement-path change for the owner. A copy changed in the project is left alone: merge it by hand from templates/github/wf-client-page.yml with __TRUSTED_BRANCH__ replaced.
The client-page workflow now runs on every push to any branch and on pull-request changes, which uses GitHub Actions minutes on private repositories.

If the client page is installed: `bin/wf-upgrade` refreshes .github/workflows/wf-client-page.yml, which no longer builds or deploys from a pull-request run (a merged pull request left a failed deploy); an enforcement-path change for the owner.

Refresh .github/workflows/wf-ci.yml (bin/wf-upgrade does it where the file is the old release's copy): it now runs when auto-merge is turned on or off and passes that to wf ci. An enforcement change for the owner.

Optional, owner-merge with checkpoint milestone or plan: turn on approval.auto_merge with bin/wf-setup, then run bin/wf-protect --apply with your own login so GitHub allows auto-merge, and replace AGENTS.md's merge sentence with the new scaffold's (a governing change).

Optional, same checkpoints: approval.defer_to_acceptance moves changes to acceptance tests, scenario changes from work found along the way, and accepted findings that are not blocking to the milestone's acceptance; the agent lists each accepted finding in its task record's accepted_findings.

Optional: config.review names a second model for deep and milestone reviews (review.second_model, e.g. codex gpt-6.1-sol at most high) and the paths that always need a deep review (review.deep_paths); bin/wf-setup finds whether Codex is installed and signed in. A project profile that spelled out its own review rules can point to config.review instead.

Optional: set acceptance_evidence to true so the pull request that accepts a milestone carries its review, the trial walkthrough and what was deferred (templates/acceptance-evidence.json). New scaffolds set it.

If the client page is installed: bin/wf-upgrade refreshes .github/workflows/wf-client-page.yml, whose jobs now report as `client page dispatch`, `client page build` and `client page deploy`, so its skipped jobs no longer answer for a project's own required `build` or `deploy` check; an enforcement-path change for the owner.

Refresh .github/workflows/wf-ci.yml, wf-status.yml and, if installed, wf-client-page.yml (bin/wf-upgrade does it where a file is the old release's copy; a copy changed in the project takes the runs-on line and the fetch step by hand). An enforcement change for the owner.

Optional: run the project's CI on the owner's machine (server/ci-runner/README.md), then set the repository variables CI_RUNNER and WF_CI_RUNNER; the project's own CI uses runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }} for its product jobs.

Before the workflow repository becomes private: set the secret WF_READ_TOKEN, as an Actions secret and a Dependabot secret, to a fine-grained token with access to that repository only and Contents: Read-only, and record its expiry. A project CI job of its own that fetches the validator (an acceptance job) takes the same GIT_CONFIG block as wf-ci.yml's fetch step.
The client page now rebuilds on the trusted branch, on pull request events, daily, and every 15 minutes with a gate runner; it no longer rebuilds on every push to every branch.
Optional: wf paths reports planning_only, which a project's CI may use to skip its product steps on records-only changes (procedures/delivery.md).

On a host with the owner's CI runners: re-run server/ci-runner/install-host.sh. ci-runner's init no longer resets the profiles' limits a host has set with lxc profile set, and LXD's daemon now starts at every boot. Then run sudo ci-runner create NAME build|gate again for each existing container: it sets boot.autostart on the container itself, without which the containers stayed stopped after a power cut.

Refresh .github/workflows/wf-ci.yml: wf ci now takes the gate runner only for pull requests into the trusted branch, by the fixed label wf-gate when the variable WF_GATE is on (bin/wf-upgrade does it, filling in the branch, where the file is the old release's copy). A copy changed in the project takes the runs-on line and the first step by hand: runs-on: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref == '<trusted branch>' && vars.WF_GATE == 'on' && 'wf-gate' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}. An enforcement change for the owner. wf-status.yml and wf-client-page.yml gain a first step that checks the branch name exactly (refreshed the same way).

Before switching WF_GATE on: delete or update any branch whose .github/workflows/wf-ci.yml predates v2.5.1, since v2.5.0's sends every pull request into that branch to the gate. Turn on Settings, General, Automatically delete head branches.

If the project used v2.5.0's runner variables: the owner adds the label wf-build to the build runner and wf-gate to the gate runner (Settings, Actions, Runners; an admin's step), or registers them again with ci-runner register OWNER/REPO NAME...; then set CI_BUILD=on and WF_GATE=on, change the project's own CI to runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD == 'on' && 'wf-build' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}, and delete CI_RUNNER and WF_CI_RUNNER. Any write collaborator can set a variable, so labels now live in the workflow files.

scripts/wf: bin/wf-upgrade replaces the launcher bin/wf-adopt wrote before v2.6.0 with templates/scripts/wf, which passes an explicit --repo on and tells wf next of a newer release (an enforcement change). A copy changed in the project takes the new one by hand.

.github/workflows/wf-ci.yml and .claude/agents/independent-reviewer.md are refreshed where unchanged: the summary names the workflow version that judged the change, and the reviewer records it (enforcement changes).

Milestones in progress: bin/wf-upgrade sets their workflow_version to the new release, and merging the upgrade is the owner's decision to move them (procedures/maintenance.md); in manual mode the round's governing-change receipt lists those milestone records. From now on the pull request that authorises a milestone sets workflow_version to the pin.
Session outcomes name the workflow version they ran under (workflow: {version, revision}); wf next prints it and templates/session.json has the field.

.claude/agents/trial-walker.md and .claude/agents/independent-reviewer.md are refreshed where unchanged: the walk runs after the milestone review and its fixes, in the background, keeping its scripts; the reviewer states each blocking finding's exposure.
Delivery evidence: a finding whose severity is blocking, critical or high needs exposure (what it exposes, to whom); a pull request whose evidence lacks it fails wf ci from this pin on.

Optional: list the project's own start-of-session checks in docs/workflow/config.json preflight, for example { "name": "staging deploy access", "run": "ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 STAGING true" }; wf doctor runs them (a workflow change for the owner).
New helpers, which grant nothing: wf brief --lead, wf doctor, wf wait, wf done, wf evidence --json, and next_ids in wf next.

wf wait returns pending (exit status 4) after 270 s instead of waiting up to 30 min, so a waiting agent keeps its prompt cache: call it again, or pass --timeout MINUTES for one longer wait. New: wf wait --commit SHA for the trusted branch's checks on a commit.
Session outcomes: friction is written, never pre-filled; wf session refuses an empty one. templates/session.json gains an optional models object.

Optional roles in docs/workflow/config.json: without it the defaults apply (lead sonnet at low effort, paperwork haiku at low, walker sonnet at medium, the implementer at its task's review level). A project whose agents run on another harness sets its own model names.

Found tasks: a task of an Authorised or Active milestone that is not in the milestone's tasks: list now needs found_from and room in the milestone's found_tasks (0-3), or readiness refuses it and says to ask the owner. Before moving a milestone in progress to this pin, add both, or add the task to tasks: (the owner's change).

baseline_result may be pending: <run> at the claim; fill it before verification (wf wait --commit). Delivery evidence: a blocking finding may name carried_by, paths and merge_increases_exposure (with approval.defer_to_acceptance).

Delivery evidence refuses a malformed paths, carried_by or merge_increases_exposure on any finding. A change that edits or removes a task record Done on the trusted branch, in a milestone not yet accepted, is now the owner's merge: put such corrections in the acceptance pull request, and remove Done records after acceptance with wf prune.

New helpers, which grant nothing: wf prune --milestone M (records-only removal of an accepted milestone's Done records), the startable set and the second-model budget in wf next, and wf doctor's check that the session started in the repository root.
